name: enum-group-value-observed-by-its-number
description: A value of an enumerated type that code observes by its number, rather than only comparing it with other values of the type, would change behaviour when a deletion renumbers the members after the deleted one. Printing it, indexing an array with it, converting it, using it as an array length or a type argument, handing it through an interface or to reflection, and exposing a variable of the type by linkname each observe or produce it so, and retain a member whose deletion renumbers a named one. A member after the last named one moves nothing when deleted and is reported.
